notes:
Summary: Mnemosyne builds enterprise-scale semantic search for regulated verticals (financial + healthcare customers). Primary focus: massive-scale embedding index (target 350M–800M vectors) with a lightweight LLM reranker for top-k results. They are cost-sensitive at unit level — target cost-per-query <= $0.0008 for pure ANN and <= $0.005 for ANN + rerank at production scale. Key asks: sustained ingest at 100M/day peak, sub-120ms P95 for ANN-only queries, overall P95 <= 250ms when reranker invoked, deterministic fallbacks during capacity constraints.

Tech constraints / preferences: prefer open quantized embedding model (80-bit/8bit quantization), want options for HNSW index + sharded ANN, plan to use top-k (k=100) retrieval then LLM rerank on top-10. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching, cache TTLs, and quantization profiles. Intend to use vector dedup and incremental upserts (delta indexing) during nightly windows.

Security & compliance: EU data residency mandatory; need SSO (SAML), KMS integration for keys, audit logging retention 90 days, SOC2 + ISO27001 required for procurement. Air-gapped option desirable for some customers (legal).

Eng notes / quotes: "We need to prove cost & latency at 100M+ scale before legal will sign; show a realistic unit-cost model."

POC asks: 1) Dedicated trial in eu-west-1 sized for 8–12 GPUs for ANN + 4 GPUs for rerank nodes; 2) ingest plan + performance knobs (batch sizes, shard count, index build windows); 3) a billing projection for 350M vectors and 700 QPS steady-state; 4) security questionnaire answers + architecture diagram.

Sales shorthand: large, technical buyer; procurement on fast track if perf/cost goal proven. Keep conversations with infra/sre and security tight.
